messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick capture from Zenith Health onboarding call just now — they passed along a bundle of asks. Starting a thread to stitch together requests and whether any are quick wins for next sprint. Main themes: search relevance, per-route billing docs, bulk invites UX, and embeddings freshness detection.

Marco (PM): thanks Aisha. can you paste the raw asks here? we should tag severity (blocker/low) and which team owns. :clipboard:

Aisha (CSM): pasted notes below (raw):
- "search results rank low when query includes org-specific terms" (affects admin workflows)
- "billing shows aggregated usage, need per-route breakdown by feature"
- "bulk invite CSV fails on rows with extra whitespace"
- "embeddings appear stale after dataset updates, need TTL or invalidation hook"

Riley (CSE): copying prod logs pattern — search relevance could be an index vs model prompt issue. can you share an example query+expected vs actual?

Aisha (CSM): example: `query = \"cardiology protocol update site:zenith\"` — expected top 3 from org docs, got generic articles. I'll DM logs but posting sanitized sample in ticket.

Devon (Onboarding): bulk invite bug sounds like CSV parser trimming issue. low lift to add `.strip()` on import loop? can reproduce with a sample file, will attach. :mag:

Nora (Product Ops): Per-route billing is a known ask across 3 customers. We have a draft spec (link: https://redwood.internal/ops/per-route-billing) — maybe prioritize as a GA request. Can we estimate effort (S/M/L)?

Marco (PM): estimate request:
- per-route billing export: M (backend + analytics + UI)
- search relevance triage: S (investigate dataset/prompt, then decide model/tuning)
- bulk invite CSV trim: XS (patch and release)
- embeddings freshness (TTL/invalidation): M (signal + cache invalidation plumbing)

Aisha (CSM): Zenith marks per-route billing as high (renewal discussion next quarter). bulk invite is high friction for new orgs today. search relevance is affecting their adoption of internal doc search.

Riley (CSE): propose quick action:
1) ship CSV trim hotfix this week (patch release)
2) open an investigation ticket for search relevance with labeled examples (owner: eng-ml)
3) backlog per-route billing as customer-driven feature; create PRD draft and schedule discovery with finance
4) embeddings TTL: propose a config flag for customers to set TTL, small-engineering spike to validate

feedback-bot: Ticket created: CS-4382 (Zenith onboarding asks) — includes attachments and tags: billing, search, csv, embeddings.

Devon (Onboarding): I can send the failing CSV sample and steps to reproduce to CS-4382 now.

Nora (Product Ops): I'll fold CS-4382 into the customer signals board and mark renewal risk as medium until per-route billing decision.

Marco (PM): thanks team — Aisha, can you add priority labels from Zenith (they indicated per-route billing = P0, bulk invite = P1, search = P1, embeddings = P2) into the ticket? I'll schedule a 30m discovery with finance + eng next Wed.

Aisha (CSM): done — I added Zenith priorities and attached the onboarding notes and quotes. ping me if you need verbatim quotes. :white_check_mark:

Riley (CSE): tagging @eng-ml for search triage. any preference for experiments (prompt tweak vs hybrid index)?

Marco (PM): start with prompt/overlay testing first (fast), then evaluate index tuning if needed. update CS-4382 with results.

Aisha (CSM): closing loop here — I’ll follow up with the customer next week with our action plan and link to the ticket. thanks all. :rocket:
